method: grep (--include *.js *.json *.md) over tools/slides_*.js and assets/research/**/manifest.json; slide mapping from slide-module function names and titles; image sizes via PIL; live checks via WebFetch.
live_check_summary: Confirmed by WebFetch: Fortune (Jul 21), Hugging Face blog (Jul 27), The Register (Sep 28). Blocked: CNN (HTTP 451), BBC and The Guardian (WebFetch could not fetch). All others not checked live; their wording is the deck record.
not_found: Exact headline for the Asymmetric Security Oct 1 report: no headline recorded in the deck.
Live text of the NYT, CNN, BBC and Guardian Medicare and Oct 3 pieces: blocked, so the deck record is used.
Hawley hearing "Rogue AI: Securing the Homeland Against AI Agent Attacks" (30 Sep 2026): appears only in an unsourced claims list in the xrisk research; not used as a candidate.
notes: y2mate.gs was not visited. The research needs no downloads, and it is a third-party video downloader. Tell me the purpose if you want that step.
Quotes are kept to short headlines and fragments. Full article text was not reproduced.
Dates are the deck manifest dates; where the URL path date differs, both are recorded in the notes.
